interpretation.resident: Stable cached normalized records reduce downstream preparation on sparse updates and unrelated global epoch changes; scans and extra cache memory remain. Full replacement regresses. Prototype not enabled.
interpretation.forest: Surface-derived binary canopy proxies reduce GPU work but increase foliage coverage and fill holes. This is not Nanite virtualized geometry or its volumetric shading. Prototype not enabled.
interpretation.bounds: 512x512 standalone contexts and prescribed scenarios; no Minecraft frame time or full-game CPU/GPU utilization inference. Tiny distant masks make IoU sensitive to individual pixels.
interpretation.notTested: Production Iris integration, real client FPS, resource-pack leaf textures, dynamic whole-world proxy handoff, temporal occlusion changes, repeated-part instancing, RDG, complete Nanite.
